projects.title: Portfolio Website
projects.summary: The website you are looking at: a full-stack portfolio with a React front end and an Express API, built step by step with automated tests, accessibility checks and CI.
projects.description:
A personal portfolio built as a real full-stack application instead of a static page.

The front end is a React single-page app with its own design system, light and dark themes and an accessible page frame. The server is an Express application that validates its configuration on start and answers with one consistent JSON format.
projects.problem: A portfolio should show engineering ability, not only list it. A static page of links cannot show how its author handles structure, testing, accessibility or security.
projects.solution: Build the portfolio itself as the proof: a monorepo with a React client, an Express server and shared data, checked on every push by automated formatting, linting, tests and a production build.
features: Light, dark and system themes, applied before the first paint so the page never flashes
Keyboard-friendly layout: skip link, a menu that works without a mouse, and focus moved to each new page's heading
Colour contrast of every design token checked against WCAG AA by automated tests
Page content (skills, projects, experience, blog) lives in files in the repository and is checked by a script, so the site needs no CMS and no login
A contact form checked in the browser and again on the server, with a hidden trap field, a limit per visitor and no personal data in the logs; messages are stored in PostgreSQL
Continuous integration that runs the format check, lint, tests and build on every push

architecture.description: The browser loads a React single-page app that reads its content from files in the repository. The only server feature is the contact form: the Express API validates a message, limits how often one visitor can send, stores it in PostgreSQL and can email a notification.

layers.name: Frontend
layers.detail: React single-page app built with Vite; content comes from files in the repository

layers.name: API
layers.detail: POST /api/contact for the contact form, plus /healthz and /readyz health checks

layers.name: Backend
layers.detail: Express server with validation, rate limiting and central error handling
